scope: One public-room run; 2 actual native Windows release Game processes and 6 native Bots, 4v4 with two allied humans. Initial 500 units, formal HP, normal AI, economy and fog; no rendering benchmark or fixed 500-live-unit guarantee. No additional seven-human testing.

fixture.population_upgrades: Fixture gives both existing military capacity upgrades to each owner; resulting limit100, actual supply72 or73, six farmers each; no balance resource changes.
fixture.bot_pause: Only initialization and two-client readiness barrier; original six Bot objects restored synchronously in begin_combat before observation.
fixture.finish: Explicit host end_battle fixture invokes canonical reliable finish after observation; not natural-victory acceptance.

stress_metrics.scope: Two headless Game processes and six native Bots share one CPU. Formal HP; initial 500 units may die or be replaced by normal production. Native ENet counters include transport traffic; not separate machines or rendering FPS. Normal fog means every observer may see fewer than 500 units.

traffic.scope: Accumulated native counters since observation start, sampled once per health row. Values remain partial if transport closes.

sampled_scene_unit_nodes.scope: Unit container children at 1Hz; includes fading corpses; guest counts only permitted visible/allied entities.
